name: screenbot-editor-bridge
description: Gives ScreenBot the real editor buffer, diagnostics, and safe hash-checked edits. Works in VS Code, Antigravity, Cursor, and other VS Code-based editors.

screenbot.bridgePort.description: Override the ScreenBot bridge port. 0 reads the port from %APPDATA%/ScreenBot/bridge.json.

screenbot.formatOnApply.description: Run the document formatter after ScreenBot applies code. Off by default because it reformats the whole file.
